title: The normalized principal quotient unit detects actual integral derived completeness
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and Y a scheme. Set R to the actual completed integral commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and t to the actual constant uniformizer section [lem-a1-principal-koszul-strict-replacement]. Let C be any universal principal quotient completion Model(R,t), including its counit, K-flat computation, strict augmentation with the quotient product coordinate and zero shifted coordinate, and compatible natural derived unit [def-pur-principal-quotient-completion-model]. For every K in the unbounded derived category of the actual completed-coefficient module sheaves, IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted(l,E,Y,K) [def-weil-derived-complete] holds if and only if C.unit at K is an isomorphism. No equality between the site and coefficient universes is assumed.

proof.text: Work on the actual pro-etale site, with independent site and coefficient universes. The completed exact sequence identifies the categorical cokernel of each positive uniformizer power with the restricted actual finite coefficient sheaf. Collapse the tensor with its degree-zero complex using the single-complex tensor isomorphism. The normalized independent-universe extension-tensor comparison sends the quotient unit to the actual scalar-extension augmentation x mapped to 1 tensor x. Check this equality on sections, including the casts from the normalized reduction functor.

Tensor preserves colimits, so every degree of the quotient augmentation is an epimorphism. Cancel those epimorphisms to show that the levelwise comparisons commute with differentials and with the quotient transitions. This constructs an augmentation-compatible strict tower isomorphism. Apply the Roos functor. Its biproduct-coordinate formula and the Model coordinates identify the resulting augmentation with the actual integral Roos unit on both coordinates, including its zero shifted coordinate.

Choose a flat-term K-flat representative using the good-complex localization already supplied by the integral operations. Obtain the adic coefficient datum from the strict-replacement theorem, and choose an auxiliary prime larger than l. Conditions (i) and (v) of the existing independent-universe intrinsic/Roos completeness equivalence identify actual unrestricted derived completeness with invertibility of the actual integral completion unit.

On the chosen K-flat representative the supplied Model counit is invertible. Its unit-computes equation, the augmentation-compatible Roos isomorphism, and the normalized actual completion comparison identify the two units after invertible postcompositions. Naturality at the representative isomorphism gives the same comparison for K. Cancel the invertible postcompositions to obtain the stated criterion. No universal derived-functor uniqueness theorem or transport to a small model is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem completedIntegralPrincipalUnitCriterion
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t})
    (C : @PrincipalQuotientCompletion.Model.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1) + 1}
      Y.ProEt inferInstance (essentiallySmallSelf.{u} _)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) inferInstance
      (integralCoefficientAbSheafify.{t, u} Y)
      (integralCoefficientAbLocallyBijective.{t, u} Y)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
      (integralTowerHasDerivedCategory l E Y)
      (PrincipalKoszulStrictReplacement.uniformizer l E Y)) :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E Y),
      IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E Y K ↔ IsIso (C.unit.app K)
